subject: LINE clause
notes: kb/Work PB565 (vertical axis). 'Within a given report group description entry, an entry that contains a LINE clause shall not have a subordinate entry that also contains a LINE clause' is screened over the FLAT report-group entry array once per RD, before the walk, so a subtree REPLAY (13.18.38.4 GR10) cannot report one violation once per repetition. Diagnostic COBOL2199, the LINE clause syntax-rule family. The rule is what makes GR10's vertical pair exhaustive rather than overlapping - GR10c is 'the entry also contains a relative LINE clause', GR10d 'the entry is a group entry having subordinate entries with relative LINE clauses' - so the axis decision has exactly one answer per entry. A single-operand LINE clause is COBOL-85 syntax, so the rule and its rejection apply at all four editions.
